upstream: none: our own code in bots/xchain-monitor
_notes: detect: the passive cross-chain spread monitor. Read-only (eth_chainId, eth_getCode, eth_call); it never signs, trades or bridges. Writes data/fleet/xchain-spreads.jsonl and the metrics file above.
paper and live: empty on purpose. Cross-chain trading needs inventory on both chains and is Joshua's decision; see docs/fleet/xchain-monitor.md.

Needs in bots/wrapper/.env (names only): BASE_RPC_URL, ARB_RPC_URL, OP_RPC_URL, ETH_RPC_URL. A chain without a URL is skipped and named in the heartbeat detail. Optional: XCHAIN_INTERVAL_MS, XCHAIN_NOTIONAL_USD, XCHAIN_MIN_NET_BPS, XCHAIN_CONFIG.
Needs Node >= 22.18 (runs the .ts files directly, no build step).
